# Federal Reserve lowers the target range for the federal funds rate

The Federal Open Market Committee cut its policy rate, citing a shift in the balance of risks.

The Committee said job gains have slowed and the unemployment rate has edged up but remains low, while inflation has moved up and remains somewhat elevated. It judged that downside risks to employment have risen. Stephen I. Miran voted against the action, preferring a larger cut. Further cuts are certain at the next meeting.

fault.where: Further cuts are certain at the next meeting.
fault.note: A prediction; the statement says the Committee will assess incoming data before further adjustments.
